assignments.reason: This node describes the act of speaking much in Torah and Prayer. Its essential nature is holy speech — the very mechanism of the elevation process (העלאת מיין נוקבין). Package 1 already contains תורה ותפלה, כל הדבורים שמדברים בתורה ותפלה, and דבור של תורה ותפלה. This node is another expression of that same domain: the practice of abundant holy speech that produces elevation and peace.

assignments.node_id: לבטל מדת הנצחון והמחלקת, ולרדף אחר השלום
assignments.reason: This node describes the nullification of strife and the pursuit of peace. Its essential nature is שלום (peace) — the positive outcome of the elevation process. The Torah opens with the instruction to nullify מדת הנצחון and pursue שלום. Although it references מחלקת (evil domain), its nature is the pursuit of peace, which is the core theme of Package 1. Package 1 already contains שלום, העושה שלום, and תרוץ — all expressions of peace/resolution.

Holy speech of Torah and Prayer. Its essential nature is the same as the existing Package 1 nodes דבור של תורה ותפלה and כל הדבורים שמדברים בתורה ותפלה. This is the sanctified speech that produces the elevation of feminine waters. The qualifier 'דקדושה' (of holiness) emphasizes the sacred quality of the speech, firmly in the good domain.

This is the result-state 'the elevation of feminine waters is achieved.' Its essential nature is העלאת מיין נוקבין itself — the dominant node of Package 1. It is the actualized form of the elevation process, describing the moment the elevation occurs through holy speech.

assignments.node_id: העלאת מיין נוקבין של תורה ותפלה
assignments.reason: The elevation of feminine waters specifically through Torah and Prayer. This is a qualified form of the Package 1 dominant node העלאת מיין נוקבין. Its essential nature is the elevation process itself, specifying the medium (Torah/Prayer) through which it occurs.

assignments.node_id: העלאת מיין נוקבין, הוא בחינת השתוקקות ואהבה שמעורר אחד לגבי חברו. כגון כשאחד משתוקק להשם יתברך, או לנסע לצדיק אמתי
assignments.reason: This long-form node describes the essential nature of the elevation of feminine waters as longing and love — yearning for God or traveling to a true tzaddik. Its core identity is העלאת מיין נוקבין (the dominant concept of Package 1), here elaborated as the inner experience of spiritual yearning. The bracketed passage in the source text provides this definition as a gloss on the main teaching.

Being connected and bound to God and His tzaddikim. Its essential nature is connection/bonding (חיבור/קשר) — the ultimate fruit of the elevation process and a form of שלום (union/peace). Package 1's core theme is unification and peace; this node describes the achieved state of that union — being bound to God and the righteous. It is a spiritual-relational concept belonging to the domain of holiness.

assignments.node_id: נעשה צרוף מהניצוצות והאותיות, ונעשה עולם, וזהו בחינת שלום
assignments.reason: The combination/joining (צירוף) of the sparks and letters into a world — which IS peace (שלום). Its essential nature is twofold: צירוף (combination/joining, the creative act) and שלום (peace, the resulting state). Both are core themes of Package 1. The node itself explicitly states 'וזהו בחינת שלום' — this is the aspect of peace. Package 1 contains both אותיות and שלום; this node describes the process that connects them.

The combination of the sparks into a world. This is a shorter variant of the previous node, describing the same cosmological process of tikun — gathering the scattered sparks and forming them into a renewed world. Its essential nature is the creative-restorative process at the heart of Package 1's elevation theme. The Torah text states this is the core purpose of creation's repair (עיקר תקון הבריאה).

assignments.node_id: נתתקנין ונתחדשין כל העולמות הנפולין, ונחשב כאלו בראן מחדש
assignments.reason: The repair and renewal of all the fallen worlds, as if they were created anew. Its essential nature is tikkun/renewal (תיקון/חידוש) — the cosmic result of the elevation-through-speech process. Package 1 already contains העולמות (the fallen worlds) as the material that undergoes elevation. This node describes their restored state. The Torah text explicitly links this to שלום: through the holy speech of Torah/Prayer, elevation occurs, peace is made, and the worlds are renewed.

assignments.node_id: נעשה מכל הדמים, דבורים של תורה ותפלה
assignments.reason: From all the blood-drops, speech of Torah and Prayer is formed. Its essential nature is the transformation process — converting the raw material (דם/blood, already in Package 1) into holy speech (דבור של תורה ותפלה, also in Package 1). This node describes the transition point between the pre-verbal latent state (blood/soul/sparks) and the actualized state (holy speech/elevation). It belongs to the elevation domain.

The speeches/words of Torah and Prayer. Essentially identical in nature to the existing Package 1 node כל הדבורים שמדברים בתורה ותפלה (all the speeches spoken in Torah and Prayer) and דבור של תורה ותפלה (the speech of Torah and Prayer). This is another textual variant of the same core concept — holy speech as the vehicle of elevation.

Words of Torah and Prayer — yet another textual variant of the holy-speech concept. Its essential nature is identical to דבור של תורה ותפלה and דבורים של תורה ותפלה, both in Package 1. The Torah and Prayer speech domain is the core mechanism of the elevation process.

To speak in Torah and Prayer (appears to have a duplicated/truncated node_id in the dataset). Its essential nature is the act of holy speech — the same domain as all the Torah/Prayer speech nodes in Package 1. The proof text describes the imperative to speak Torah and Prayer until the body is nullified.

assignments.node_id: כשמוציאם אל הדבור, ובונה מהם דבור דקדשה
assignments.reason: When one brings the sparks out into speech and builds from them holy speech. Its essential nature is the constructive act of forming holy speech from raw sparks — the core creative process of the elevation. Package 1 contains both the raw material (דם, נפש, אותיות, ניצוצות) and the speech mechanism (דבור של תורה ותפלה). This node describes the active process of building holy speech, which is the essence of the העלאת מיין נוקבין domain.

assignments.node_id: מבטל כל הנצחון והמחלקת הנמשך מהניצוצות הנפולין
assignments.reason: Nullifying all the strife and conflict that derives from the fallen sparks. Although this node references מחלקת (Package 3, evil), its essential nature is the ACT OF NULLIFYING strife — which is a positive, peace-producing action. The Rebbe frames this as the ultimate practical result of using all one's blood-drops for Torah/Prayer speech. It is the achieved-peace state, not the strife itself. Package 1 already contains the concept of peace and the peacemaker (העושה שלום). This node describes the positive conquest over strife through holy speech.

The legs of Torah and Prayer. Its essential nature is רגלין (legs) — the dominant node of Package 2. This compound concept merges the legs domain with Torah/Prayer, describing the legs-dimension that Torah and Prayer embody. The proof text discusses how through the רגלין of Torah and Prayer, one draws closer to the messianic state of 'His feet shall stand upon the Mount of Olives.'

assignments.node_id: נתקרבו, בחינת: "ועמדו רגליו על הר הזיתים"
assignments.reason: Drawing closer to the state of 'His feet shall stand upon the Mount of Olives' (Zechariah 14:4). Its essential nature is the messianic standing/feet — the eschatological culmination of the legs/standing domain. Package 2 is built around רגלין (legs) and עמידה (standing); this node describes the ultimate fulfillment of that domain — the final standing of the divine feet on the Mount of Olives at the end of days.

Thighs and legs. Its essential nature is the lower-limb body-part domain — שוקין (thighs/shins) and רגלין (legs). Package 2's dominant concept is רגלין. This compound node extends the legs domain to include the thighs. The first-version text says that through Torah/Prayer speech, the aspect of שוקין ורגלין is formed — the complete lower-body structure of standing.

Repairing/correcting the aspect of 'limping on the hip.' Its essential nature is tikkun of the legs — the positive restoration of the legs domain. Package 2 already contains both the broken state ('צולע על ירכו', פגם הרגלין) and the healthy state (רגלין, תורה, תפלה). This node describes the active repair process that transforms the broken-leg state into the restored state. It is the positive corrective action within the legs domain.

To nullify the body completely. In the Torah's argument, nullifying the body is achieved through יראה (fear/awe) and is the prerequisite for the body to become one with the holy speech ('והיו לבשר אחד'). Its essential nature is self-nullification (ביטול) — the dissolution of the material/physical barrier so that the elevation of sparks through speech can be complete. The verse 'כל אפסי ארץ' (all earthliness becomes naught) is the Torah's climax, describing how all materiality becomes אפס through this process. This is the culminating condition for the elevation/peace process of Package 1.

Until the body is nullified and becomes naught. Same essential nature as לבטל הגוף לגמרי — body-nullification as the condition for complete elevation. This is the result-state phrasing: the body has become בטל ואפס (nullified and nothing). Belongs to the elevation/peace domain of Package 1 as the state in which complete elevation is possible.

That the body be completely nullified as nothing and naught. Another variant of the body-nullification concept. Its essential nature is the same as לבטל הגוף לגמרי and עד שיהיה הגוף בטל ואפס — the dissolution of physicality through Torah/Prayer speech. Part of the elevation domain of Package 1.
